summary: Bind explicit native CapturePlan setup and scalar metadata to main

replay.detail: No replay, rebuild or automatic source installation.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or trigger installation.

rules.detail: No source admission, authority or canonical ordering change.

compatibility.detail: CapturePlan validates main table columns and main source/deferred metadata despite TEMP shadows. Its scalar expressions and subqueries target main. Existing trigger DML remains an ordinary-main-trigger-only fragment; gap_main_sql is additive for execution outside triggers.

downtime.detail: No native production activation or default Store path change.

manual.detail: Owners must install ordinary main-schema triggers with explicit main targets. Use gap_main_sql outside triggers; physical schema, complete coverage and lifetime validation remain source-owned.

recovery.detail: No automatic recovery or Ready restoration; storage failures still require source transaction rollback.
